_readme: AUTHORITATIVE level data: the 36 runtime level definitions (LEVELS[i] after every build step and load-time override), read from the running game of this repo's index.html through the editor hook (src/levels6/patch/v15-editor.js, __blast.editor.defs()). Source files: src/levels6/tools/src-l1-12.js (L1-12), src/levels6/tools/src-l13-36.js + src/levels6/levels-v6-l13-36.json (L13-36), src/levels6/patch/v15-a1.js (L1-5 remade, batch A1), src/levels6/patch/v14-monument.js (L32).
Units: metres; x right, z towards the street and the default camera; yaw in radians. tier: T tutorial, N normal, R relief/teach, H hard (purple badge, hard:true), SH boss (orange badge, boss:true).

parts = target buildings (part 'A' is usually the hero). kind 'mass' + tiers = a plain building (f storeys, cx/cz bays, mat wood|brick|conc|steel, skin/g wall styles); a 'kit' = an explicit member list [memberKey, x, y, z, w, h, d, floor, ...] for hero landmarks; other kinds (a1mill, a1light, mon14 ...) are built by named hero builders in the patches.

keeps = protected (blue) buildings, max 5 % damage. tanks = explosive barrels [x, z]. charges = TNT given. base = per-building base rule (weak / weak-tip / stiff / stiff-tip / crush / keep / none, see materials.json basePresets). sol / solW = the expert solution [charge, 'part:face', floor, index] (one list per blast in solW); bot.hints = what the sensible bot reads; lesson.check = the plan without the lesson; tip / ftip = level tip and fail tip text (rewritten at runtime to 'principle, no spot' by D-blast-NOHINT); hint / dotTip / monIn / a1cue2 = older placement-aid fields, ignored in the default build (no placement hints).
target is always 0.85 at runtime (the game forces PASS 85 % on every level).
levels-measured.json = the measured footprint of every part / protected building (bounding box x0..x1, z0..z1, height h, radius r, member count n, members by key) and the base rule the game applied.

levels.name: Old Whirly
levels.ftip: Two front posts, side by side. Then the barn.

levels.name: Stripey Point
levels.tip:
Tip the lighthouse
onto the row.
levels.dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side!
levels.ftip: Three legs facing the row. Then the far huts.

levels.name: Old Tock
levels.tip:
Start the row
from the right.
levels.dud: Not yet. Two legs side by side, facing the row!
levels.ftip: Fill the dots on the legs facing the row.

levels.name: Needle Court
levels.teaches: Turn the view: blast the open back
levels.tip:
Turn around.
Blast the back.
levels.dud: Not yet. Two back legs side by side!
levels.ctip: It fell on {hit}. Blast the BACK legs.
levels.ftip: Turn around. Fill the dots on the back legs.

levels.name: Doorstop Corner
levels.tip:
Tip it away
from the blue.
levels.dud: Not yet. Three legs in a row on one side!
levels.ctip: It fell on {hit}. Blast the far side.
levels.ftip: Fill the dots on the three left legs.

levels.name: Dome Square
levels.tip:
Knock out the back.
Mind the school.
levels.ftip: Back row first, then the arcades.

levels.name: Grand Arch
levels.tip:
HARD. Fall along
the street.
levels.ftip: Arch forward, tower back.

levels.name: Rivet Tower
levels.teaches: Steel holds: blast the concrete feet
levels.tip:
Steel holds.
Hit the grey feet.
levels.ftip: TNT on the concrete feet.

levels.name: Twin Saucer
levels.tip:
Tip it down the row.
Steel? Hit its feet.

levels.name: Lift Bridge
levels.tip:
BOSS! Find where
it can fall.
levels.ftip: Inner sides: they fall together.

levels.name: Shell Hall
levels.teaches: Blast in steps: clear what hides it, then the piers
levels.tip:
Clear the shed,
then the hall.
levels.ftip: Shed first. Then the piers.

levels.name: Star Pedestal
levels.tip: Look behind it.
levels.ftip: Save one TNT for the core.

levels.name: Harp Span
levels.teaches: Stack two TNT on a steel leg
levels.tip:
Steel leg?
Stack two TNT.
levels.ftip: Two TNT on one steel leg.

levels.name: Stripey Light
levels.tip:
Tip it down the row.
Stack on steel.
levels.ftip: Two TNT per steel leg.

levels.name: The Sail
levels.tip:
Open the hall.
Then stack on steel.
levels.ftip: Hall first. Then the steel legs.

levels.name: Dome Hall
levels.tip:
HARD. All fall away
from the hospital.
levels.ftip: Outer side of each. The hall: its whole back.

levels.name: The Pedestal
levels.teaches: Dark piers: one TNT on each
levels.tip:
Dark piers:
TNT on each one.
levels.ftip: One TNT on every dark pier.

levels.name: The Doorstop
levels.tip:
Look behind it.
Dark piers: TNT on each.
levels.ftip: Keep two TNT for the core.

levels.name: Cube Grove

One pole, one TNT.

levels.tip:
BOSS! Each pylon

Blast every back.

levels.name: Tube Bundle
levels.tip:
Tip it down the row,

levels.name: Deco Needle
levels.tip:
HARD. Only one way

levels.ftip: Blast the whole back row.

levels.name: Glass Point

Glass holds nothing.
Hit the dark frame.

levels.name: Sister Spires

for each spire.
levels.ftip: Left spire left. The others back.

levels.tip:
One push.

levels.name: Sky Steps
levels.tip:
BOSS! Road, school,

levels.tip:
